# runr_runtime (Resource)

A runtime plugin registered from a `runtime.yaml` manifest (docs/runtimes.md): a platform runtime for tokens with `runtimes.manage`, a custom runtime of the organization with `runtimes.use_custom`. RunR validates the manifest and builds the image of `dockerfile` and `git` versions in each region. A change of the manifest's `id` replaces the runtime; deleting a runtime that projects use fails.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A runtime plugin from its manifest and the files of its dockerfile version
# (examples/runtimes/q in the RunR repository): RunR builds the image in each region.
resource "runr_runtime" "q" {
  manifest = file("${path.module}/runtimes/q/runtime.yaml")
  files = {
    for f in fileset("${path.module}/runtimes/q/interpreter", "*") :
    f => file("${path.module}/runtimes/q/interpreter/${f}")
  }
}

# An exec runtime on an existing image, written inline.
resource "runr_runtime" "bash" {
  manifest = yamlencode({
    apiVersion = "runr.sh/v1"
    kind       = "Runtime"
    id         = "bash"
    name       = "Bash"
    extensions = ["sh"]
    versions   = [{ version = "5", image = "bash:5", default = true }]
    run = {
      mode    = "exec"
      input   = "raw"
      command = ["bash", "/app/code/{file}"]
    }
  })
  regions = [data.runr_region.eu.id]
}

# Projects use the runtime by its id.
resource "runr_project" "script" {
  name      = "hello-sh"
  type      = "xaas"
  runtime   = runr_runtime.bash.id
  region_id = data.runr_region.eu.id
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `manifest` (String) The manifest as YAML or JSON text, e.g. `file("runtime.yaml")` or `yamlencode({...})`.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether new projects can pick the runtime and its projects deploy (default `true`).
- `files` (Map of String) Files uploaded with the runtime, name → content: the Dockerfile and build context of `dockerfile` versions (flat names, at most 900 KB together).
- `regions` (List of String) Ids of the regions the runtime is offered in; unset offers it in every region.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Runtime id (the manifest's `id`), stored on projects as `runtime`.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `run_mode` (String) `http`, `exec` or `persistent`.
- `source` (String) `platform` or `custom`.
- `versions` (List of Object) Versions: `version`, `is_default`, `eol_at`, `image` (empty for versions RunR builds per region) and `built`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `built` (Boolean)
- `eol_at` (String)
- `image` (String)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `version` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <runtime id>
terraform import runr_runtime.q q
```
